name: Magyarország: Hungary Island Map
summary: Hungary as a Transport Fever 3 island: real terrain, 40 real towns.
description:
Build a transport company across Hungary.

The whole country as a playable island: real terrain, the Danube, Tisza and Lake Balaton, 40 towns where they really are and sized by population, and a set of starter industries.

Import the heightmap and towns into a new Map Editor map. The steps are in the README.

How maps like this are made: https://aimantas.com/writing/lithuania-transport-fever-3-map/

Made by Aimantas. More at aimantas.com.

Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Terrain from Mapzen Terrain Tiles, including EU-DEM (Copernicus). Full notices in ATTRIBUTION.md.
